title: Building facade alternatives: four alternatives, twelve criteria

notes: Criterion types and weights from the 2013 paper, Table 2: x1 installation cost, x2 labour intensity, x9 weight of structure and x10 thickness are minimised; the rest are maximised. The 2012 paper lists the weights of Table 1 in the reverse column order; the normalised values identify the columns unambiguously.
Input correction: the 2013 paper prints x3 of a2 as 2.37, but the 2012 normalised value 1.0000 and every Q value require 3.37 (the column maximum). The fixture uses 3.37.

Table 2 prints Q(lambda) for lambda = 0, 0.1, ..., 1 and Table 3 the standard deviation of each. Q(lambda) is linear in lambda, so the fixture keeps only its two ends, the WPM (lambda = 0) and the WSM (lambda = 1). The 2012 paper labels the columns from 1.0 down to 0 although the first column is the WPM (a weighted geometric mean can never exceed the weighted arithmetic mean); the 2013 paper prints the same numbers against lambda = 0 ... 1.

The printed WPM values are reproduced exactly; the printed WSM values of a2, a3 and a4 differ from the recomputed ones by 3-4 units in the fourth decimal (0.8292 vs 0.8288, 0.6972 vs 0.6975, 0.8520 vs 0.8516) while a1 matches. No single input or weight change explains this pattern; it is recorded as a deviation and does not affect the ranking.
Optimal lambda per alternative (Eqs. 11-19): lambda = var(Q2) / (var(Q1) + var(Q2)) with var(Q1) = sum_j w_j^2 var(x_ij), var(Q2) = sum_j (Q2 w_j / x_ij)^2 var(x_ij) and var(x_ij) = (0.05 x_ij)^2.

The paper's Table 1 prints x5 of a1 (warranty 5 of 50) as 1.0000 instead of 0.1000. Q1 and Q2 use the correct value, but the variance of a1 was evidently computed with 1.0000: it gives sigma(WSM) = 0.0108, lambda = 0.32 and Q = 0.5303 exactly as printed, while the correct normalised value gives 0.0104, 0.343 and 0.5326. These are listed as deviations; the ranking is unchanged.
